subject: Security & IR follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor QA, BCP evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Walters <erin.walters@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Security & IR follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor QA, BCP evidence

Hi Erin — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the security qualification and evidence collection forward: 

Summary of what we discussed
- Cobalt Health is evaluating Redwood for inference on protected health data; HIPAA applicability expected.
- You wanted a clear example of our incident notification timelines and what evidence the security team typically requests for BCP/DR.
- You asked for a short vendor questionnaire to reduce back-and-forth.

Asks / next steps for Cobalt Health
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm current SOC 2 posture (Type I/II, date of last audit) or an expected completion date if in progress? A PDF of the report or an auditor contact will be fine when available.
2) HIPAA: confirm whether BAA exists with any current vendors and whether you need Redwood to sign a BAA (we can provide ours).
3) Vendor QA: please start with the attached template (short questionnaire) and return the highlighted pages. We'll pre-fill any obvious vendor info to speed things up.
4) Incident response / breach notification: can you share any contractual notification windows required by Cobalt? We typically provide: initial notification, customer impact assessment, and final root-cause write-up. If Cobalt requires shorter windows than our standard, let us know.
5) BCP/DR artifacts: helpful items are: high-level DR plan excerpt, recovery time objectives (RTO / RPO), and an architecture diagram showing network boundaries for PHI.

I attached a short Redwood questionnaire and a sample IR timeline to illustrate what we can provide.

Proposed schedule
- Please return the questionnaire and any immediate SOC 2 notes by Nov 19.
- If helpful, we can do an evidence review call the week of Nov 16; suggest Thu Nov 18 10:00 AM PT.

I’m looping in Neha (compliance) and Hannah (security) to coordinate the evidence list and the review call. If there’s another technical contact on your side, please share.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-template.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-ir-timeline-sample.pdf (pdf)
From: Erin Walters <erin.walters@cobalthealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Cho <michael.cho@cobalthealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security & IR follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor QA, BCP evidence

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap and template. Quick answers below and a partial attachment to get us started.

SOC 2: we do not have an active SOC 2 Type II right now; we completed a Type I earlier this year (2026-04). We have engaged our auditors for a Type II and expect completion around 2027-02-15. We'll share the auditor contact or report as soon as it’s available.

HIPAA / BAA: Cobalt is a HIPAA-covered entity and we will require a BAA. Please send your standard BAA and we’ll route it through procurement.

Incident notification: our contracts typically expect a 48-72 hour initial notification to customers for confirmed breaches; regulators may have shorter statutory windows — we'd flag those when applicable.

Vendor QA: attaching "cobalt-vendor-qa-partial.pdf" — this is our initial answers to your questionnaire plus a couple of internal references. Michael Cho (cc) is our security lead and will own the detailed evidence collection.

We can hit your Nov 19 target for the questionnaire; Michael will coordinate artifacts. We are available for the evidence review call on Nov 18 at 10 AM PT.

—Erin
Erin Walters
Director, IT Compliance — Cobalt Health
--
Attachments: cobalt-vendor-qa-partial.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security & IR follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor QA, BCP evidence

Thanks — quick internal note and plan: 

1) Intake & scope: since Cobalt is HIPAA-covered and SOC 2 Type II is in progress, let's treat this as higher priority for evidence collection and an earlier review cadence.

2) Tailored questionnaire: I'll trim the attached template to a 1-page evidence subset (SOC/IR/BCP/architecture) to reduce lift. Jordan — once you get Michael’s contact info, please send the shortened questionnaire and mark which items are "required for procurement" vs "nice to have."

3) Evidence checklist (we'll request):
- SOC 2 Type I report (if available) and auditor contact
- High-level architecture diagram showing PHI boundaries (PDF)
- IR runbook excerpt (not full playbook) — containment and escalation steps
- BCP/DR executive summary with RTO/RPO values
- Retention and logging policy (summary)

4) Timing / kickoff: propose Nov 19 as our internal due date to have artifacts collected by Cobalt. If they can’t meet that, we’ll do a staged handoff (required first).

5) Evidence review call: Hannah and I will run the review; Sean can join for any infra-level questions. Jordan, please send the HubSpot deal and Drive links to Cobalt (I added them to related_links).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Compliance — Redwood Inference
--
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4821 ; https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d

Subject: Re: Security & IR follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor QA, BCP evidence

Neha / Jordan — thanks, this all looks good. Michael will be the point person for the artifacts and will aim to return the completed vendor QA by Nov 19. I’m attaching the completed QA; a couple items reference internal third-party reports that we can only share with an NDA — please send your standard NDA/BAA and procurement contact and we’ll escalate.

On incident windows: our contracts generally expect an initial customer notification within 48 hours of confirmation; regulatory notifications may follow once we finish impact assessments. We can call this out during the review call.

We’ll see you on Thu Nov 18 10:00 AM PT for the evidence review.

Best — Erin
Erin Walters
Director, IT Compliance — Cobalt Health
